attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) dnsmasq to authoritatively resolve app.internal -> node2's IP (10.100.189.11) via a UCI dhcp domain record, and pointed node3's NetworkManager DNS at node1 (10.100.189.10). Verified node3 resolves app.internal and reaches node2's port-8080 HTTP service by name with no /etc/hosts entry. Also stood up and firewall-opened the missing HTTP service on node2 (it was described as running but wasn't). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot_id and full functional recovery after each.
